podcast.title: "Roseanne" Role (1990s)
podcast.body: Bonnie Bramlett played the character Bonnie Watkins, a friend and coffee shop co-worker to Roseanne, in the sitcom "Roseanne" during the 1990s. "If you watched the sitcom Roseanne in the 90s, you saw her play Bonnie Watkins, a friend and coffee shop co-worker to Roseanne."
